name: The Original Chocolate Chunk Bite Size Cookies
ingredients: WHEAT FLOUR, BUTTER (CREAM, SALT), DARK CHOCOLATE 16% (SUGAR, COCOA SOLIDS, MILK SOLIDS, EMULSIFIER (SOY LECITHIN), NATURAL FLAVOUR), BROWN SUGAR, SUGAR, MILK SOLIDS, RAISING AGENT (500), SALT.
storage: ONCE OPENED, RESEAL THE POUCH OR TRANSFER COOKIES TO AN AIRTIGHT CONTAINER TO KEEP THEM FRESH.
note: PEANUT WARNING: the pack prints, verbatim, 'MAY BE PRESENT: EGG, PEANUTS, TREE NUTS AND SESAME SEEDS.' Brand attribution: the Cookie Time wordmark/logo is not itself in frame; the brand is taken from the on-pack line 'ANY TIME IS COOKIE TIME!', the Cookie Muncher character and the .co.nz web address. Net weight is not in frame (11 x 21 g is stated but that is arithmetic), so pack is left unrecorded. Ingredients and allergens are crisp and fully in frame.
